name: agent-builder-prompt-narrow-owner
body: `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` owns exactly `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`. The file has three owners: `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` (the two prompt files collectively, realised-by `domain.entity.graph-first-navigation`), `solution.component.agent-fs-permission-grants` (this file for the fs-tool grants, realised-by `domain.entity.agent-fs-operation`), and this narrow component. The narrow component exists because a satisfied requirement's spine is coverage-checked by `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check`, and the requirement's derived coverage maps 1:1 to the files it edits. Overlapping component ownership of one file is established practice here — `codebase-navigator-prompt` and `navigator-prompt-guidance` share `codebase-navigator.md`.
